# SBSA RELEASE: ISA findings (function<TAB>kind<TAB>detail): implementation-defined
# register reads/writes, hvc, AMX, GXF, and (kind "isa") instructions past the
# Armv8.2 baseline (+v8.2a,+rcpc,+dotprod,+aes,+sha2,+fullfp16: what both the
# Radxa Dragon Q8B's Cortex-X1C/A78C and QEMU's cortex-a76 implement; P1-17).
# Generated by //kernel:sbsa_isa_audit. Only these may appear:
#
# - _nd_psci_hvc (kernel/neodarwin/platform/NeoDarwinPSCI.cpp) is the PSCI HVC
#   conduit. The conduit is chosen at run time from the firmware: neoboot writes
#   /chosen psci-conduit from the FADT's ARM_BOOT_ARCH flags (docs/kernel/dt-abi.md),
#   and NeoDarwinPSCI issues this HVC only when it says "hvc", i.e. when a
#   hypervisor above the kernel implements PSCI (QEMU virt without EL3). An HVC
#   anywhere else would be UNDEFINED at EL1 with no EL2, or reach a hypervisor
#   the kernel knows nothing about.
_nd_psci_hvc	hvc	-
#
# - PSTATE.DIT (FEAT_DIT, Armv8.4) is saved and restored per thread by the
#   context-switch macros in osfmk/arm64/cswitch.s, only when gARM_FEAT_DIT says
#   the CPU has it (patch 0019); the Q8B doesn't, and never executes these.
_Idle_context	isa	mrs dit
_Idle_load_context	isa	msr dit
_machine_load_context	isa	msr dit
_Shutdown_context	isa	mrs dit
_Switch_context	isa	mrs dit
_Switch_context	isa	msr dit
#
# - Data, not code: words in __TEXT_EXEC that llvm-objdump decodes as SVE, SME
#   or CB<cc> only with every feature on. _lz4_decode_asm and _lz4_encode_2gb
#   end in constant tables (0x04030201, 0x80808081); the others are panic
#   strings the assembler placed after the function ("exce", "Pree", ": ou").
_lz4_decode_asm	isa	subr
_lz4_encode_2gb	isa	fmopa
_os_cpu_in_cksum_mbuf	isa	cblo
_update_mdscr	isa	cmla
_update_mdscr	isa	fmls
fleh_fiq_sp1	isa	fmls
fleh_fiq_sp1	isa	fnmls
fleh_irq_sp1	isa	fmls
fleh_irq_sp1	isa	fnmls
preempt_underflow	isa	fnmls
